web.title: Uploading audiobooks to Spotify for Authors
web.description:
# Uploading audiobooks to Spotify for Authors
**For:** Publishers and self-published authors with the **Upload audiobook** permission. [Learn more about access levels](https://support.spotify.com/us/authors/article/access-levels/)

1. Log in to [authors.spotify.com](https://authors.spotify.com/dash/login)
2. Click **+ Upload audiobook**.
3. Enter your audiobook’s details, audio files, and metadata.

## Tips and specs
- Use MP3, WAV, or FLAC for audio files
- Use PNG or JPEG for cover art in a 1:1 aspect ratio (recommended size: 3000 × 3000 px)
- Add a sample file to let listeners preview your audiobook
- Title your chapters clearly so listeners can navigate your audiobook easily

[Read our full audio and metadata guidelines](https://support.spotifycdn.com/pdf/SFA%20Metadata_Asset%20Guide_2024.pdf)

## Publishing issues
1. It briefly appears in **Drafts** as a submitted title.

**Note**: If it's marked as **Incomplete**, look for missing artwork or audio files.

2. While we process your audiobook, it may temporarily not appear in your Spotify for Authors catalog for a short time.
3. Within 72 hours your title will become available to listeners on Spotify.

Audiobooks are only available to Spotify listeners in [these countries](https://support.spotify.com/us/authors/article/audiobooks-availability/). If you’re located outside these regions, you won’t be able to listen to your audiobook on Spotify.
